_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 3% of 12h windows moving ±2+ points historically and no visible breaker in the divergent factors, HOLD is the statistically honest call — the coil persists until ETF flows or stablecoin growth confirm a direction.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing missing liquidity and 20.8% direction accuracy; narrative implies a bullish reversal setup with 0.78 confidence, creating a trust-weighted lean toward the analyst's caution
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND stablecoin growth turns positive with BTC momentum holding above 50 — would signal Disbelief/Hope leg beginning
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 25 with DXY above 102 AND funding flips negative — would push to Panic/Capitulation, killing the coil
